requiredFindings.title: Creation's busy SQLite results take host I/O
requiredFindings.failureScenario: write_schema maps the creation open, PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL, BEGIN IMMEDIATE, and DDL errors through Sql, and Sql.row() is host I/O. Item 10's first row is a busy ledger at level 3: LEDGER.BUSY_TIMEOUT, ledger-busy, PROJECT.BUSY. admit_attempt and open_verified already classify SQLITE_BUSY and SQLITE_LOCKED as Busy. The busy test covers admit_attempt only. Required: those two codes on the creation open, the journal-mode pragma, BEGIN IMMEDIATE, and the DDL statements are ProjectLedgerRow::Busy. Other pre-COMMIT I/O and SQL errors stay host I/O. A journal mode other than wal, and a stored schema other than the selected DDL, stay LEDGER.CORRUPT with domainDetail omitted. A creation COMMIT error stays CreationUndetermined, host I/O.

requiredFindings.title: Store custody and a changed identity take the quarantine row
requiredFindings.failureScenario: row() maps NotPrivate, Kind, Filesystem, NameChanged, and IdentityChanged to LEDGER.CORRUPT. Item 10 gives that row to a schema other than the selected DDL, a partial creation footprint other than the resumable empty file, and an unequal object. S12 fixes CONFIG.CUSTODY_REFUSED for SYMLINK and WRITABLE_BY_OTHERS, and 468c's InstallationTermination already has that arm: request-rejected, exit 2, CONFIG.INVALID, detail CONFIG.CUSTODY_REFUSED, with existing subjects mode, private, not-fresh, name-changed, and required-files-changed. A 0755 directory, a symlink, and a 0644 ledger name are left in place and reported as LedgerCorrupt. StoreCustodyRefusal::Io stays host I/O, and a malformed component stays the invariant row. Required: NotPrivate (including NotFresh), Kind, Filesystem, NameChanged, and IdentityChanged take the existing custody row and those existing subjects. Schema mismatch, a non-resumable ledger footprint, and an unequal object stay LEDGER.CORRUPT with domainDetail omitted.
